issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，条目字只有 12px（成片约 48px 但菜单整体只占画面中间一小条），四周大面积空黑
画面里只有一列菜单，没有标题、没有层级，暂停任一帧都不像一张设计过的画面
六项都是同一种深灰条，当前项只靠一层淡靛蓝区分，主次不清
漂移 32px（设计坐标）放大后与逐项位移量级接近，两层运动不够分明
changes: look 换成 graphite（近单色暗场，白为强调、香槟金点缀）：1920 原生排版，条目 700×92、46px 字、34px 线性图标、26px 等宽快捷键，左列表 + 右侧 120px 标题「Everything, within reach.」
当前项 Home 做成全片唯一的瓷白实心条，落位后一次扫光；未读徽章用香槟金，其余项深石墨面 + 发丝线
逐项找位：10f 错峰、24f 窗口，scale 0.82→1 + 上移 44px + 对焦模糊 8px→0，软 back ~1.5% 过冲；图标晚 2f、快捷键晚 4f 跟随
整体漂移改为全程匀速 96px（≈0.8px/f）：总量是单项位移 2 倍、速度慢一个数量级，两层运动一眼可分
标题等列表铺到一半（46f）才逐行升起（Q5 开场单主角），副句 36px 淡入；时长 120f，尾段 ~34f 只剩漂移与光呼吸
issuesEn: Built in 480×270 design space: 12px labels, and the whole menu was a thin strip in the middle of an empty black frame
Only a menu on screen, no headline and no hierarchy; no paused frame looked like a designed composition
All six items were the same dark grey bar; the current item differed only by a faint indigo tint
The 32px drift scaled up to roughly the same magnitude as each item's own motion, so the two layers didn't separate clearly
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark, white accent, champagne highlight) laid out natively at 1920: 700×92 rows, 46px labels, 34px line icons, 26px mono shortcuts, with a 120px headline "Everything, within reach." on the right
The current item, Home, is the only porcelain-white solid row and gets one sheen after landing; the unread badge is champagne, the rest are dark graphite with hairlines
Item settle: 10f stagger, 24f window, scale 0.82→1 plus a 44px rise and 8px→0 focus blur with a ~1.5% soft back; icons follow 2f later, shortcuts 4f later
The container drift is now a constant 96px over the shot (≈0.8px/f): twice an item's travel but an order of magnitude slower, so the two layers read separately
The headline waits until the list is half built (46f) before rising line by line (one hero at the open, Q5), with a 36px subline; 120f total, the last ~34f only drift and breathe
